origin.notes: These profiles extend the preserved upstream Access-PoD v1a release without modifying the vendored standards snapshot.

profiles.description: Enterprise introduction of AI and emerging technologies with emphasis on staged internal rollout, change governance, regulatory readiness, and approval traceability.
notes: Intended for enterprise rollout of novel AI or emerging technical capability inside an organization.
Prioritizes approval traceability, policy adaptation, workforce review, and regulatory handling over sector-specific external interoperability.
